description: All their lives, fraternal brother Luke Bridger and his identical twin sisters Tessa and Sadie wanted to do everything together—and all their lives, their parents screamed at them to spread their wings and go separate ways. title: The Story of Heather Lindstrom
short_description: Scales, Tails, and Safe People — From a panicked seventeen-year-old mistake at Northwood High and her non-verbal cousin Wesley's heartbreak to raising disabled twins Jonas and Nora and building North Lion Scales & Tails in Maplewood, Minnesota.
description: The Story of Heather Lindstrom: Scales, Tails, and Safe People follows Heather Lindstrom (née Collins) from Chesapeake and Virginia Beach to Maplewood, Minnesota. When seventeen-year-old Heather panics over a classmate's malicious rumor in January 2003 and ends her relationship with sixteen-year-old Nathaniel Prairie without letting him speak, her fifteen-year-old non-verbal cousin Wesley erupts in furious, terrified heartbreak at losing his very first guy friend. Stepping up at nineteen as Wesley's legal guardian, marrying wildlife biologist Dan Lindstrom, raising severely disabled fraternal twins Jonas and Nora alongside fiercely protective younger daughter Molly, and spending ten quiet years behind the camera lens before opening the barrier-free North Lion Scales & Tails Reptile Zoo, Heather learns what it truly takes to become a safe person.

When fourteen-year-old Julian Thomas Rowlands ('Julep')—who is non-verbal, autistic, and uses a manual wheelchair—is abducted from Ewell, Virginia on December 11, 1996 by his estranged father, his fierce twin siblings Gabriel and Gwendolyn Rowlands and his twin anchors Maria and Clara Harrison turn their living room into a war room and broadcast a symphonic rock rescue beacon across the Appalachian radio towers. Spanning from Julian's 1996 abduction and Ohio rescue, the forging of the vaulted Trilingual 'Family Mix' in Cymraeg, Québécois French, and English, and the family's 1998 return to Anglesey, Wales, to their 2007 meeting in Williamsburg with Samantha, Jyn, and Matthew—whose cross-country abduction from Norfolk to Seattle was survived using Julian's song as his sonic armor.

title: Runebreaker: The Dream Kingdom
short_description: Pulled through their CRT television in 1992, twins Ocea and Tay fight to reunite the Sundered Crystal of the realm.
description: For four hundred and four years of the Era of the Crystal, the inhabitants of the Dream Kingdom whispered of an ancient legend: that the Sundered Crystal—one half crimson, one half sapphire—would one day return to reunite the fractured code of their world. Over the centuries, as the tyrannical Grand Wizard seized the Great Directory and no trace of the two halves was ever found, the people came to believe the Crystal was nothing more than a myth. Then, on a quiet Friday night in October 1992, eighteen-year-old fraternal twins Ocea and Tay are pulled through the glass of their living room CRT television—each carrying half of the painted clay summer-camp medallion they made together in the real world. Set to the 23-track Runebreaker (Original Soundtrack) by Mana Canvas, this chronicle follows Ocea's barefoot quest in her t-shirt and jeans to rescue her older twin brother and usher in the Era of the Restored Realm.

title: The Uncharted Waystation
short_description: Pulled barefoot from their tiny studio bed into Vaeloria, Nolan (24) and Gwen (19) journey toward home.
description: At twenty-one, verbal autistic retail associate Nolan Lennox (5'7") missed every hidden signal when polite, five-foot-tall Tammy puffed out her chest over a Day-1 lunch at the Emerald Creek Mall food court and told him she was ready for everything—soon finding himself rushed into her un-air-conditioned trailer off Route 13. Two years and two breakups later, when Tammy impulsively drags twenty-three-year-old Nolan to the Norfolk Pathfinder terminal for a surprise Seattle trip without calling forty-eight hours ahead for a wheelchair lift, Nolan breaks up with her for good, rejects her last-ditch sexual enticement in favor of peaceful, yell-free hugs with his neurotypical six-foot-one sister Gwen, and rides CVTA buses home after fellow passengers shield him from Tammy's slap. Grandpa Walter holds on to see Gwen turn eighteen—where an overjoyed Gwen accepts Nolan's invite to live together—before passing away the next morning, leaving Nolan and Gwen to weather probate, sell their childhood home, and share tiny rectangular Studio 205 inside a nineteen-sixties Norfolk high-rise until an amber rift pulls them barefoot on Lofstrand forearm crutches into twin-moon Vaeloria.
